name: Earnings Drift Watcher
description: Judges one thing only: whether the market has finished reacting to a reported surprise. Compares the reported figure against what was expected, then against how far the price has already travelled, and mostly concludes that it is too late.

agents.name: Earnings Drift Watcher
agents.description: Post-announcement drift, as a single question. Reads the reported figure against expectation, measures how much of the resulting move has already happened, and returns WATCH far more often than it returns anything else — because the answer to 'has the market finished reacting' is usually 'ask again later'.

capabilities.reason: The reported figure, the expectation it is measured against, and the price history around the announcement — asked of the data sources this machine holds credentials for. The responses are the vendors’, unread by Aumos. A surprise nobody has priced and a surprise fully priced are the same fundamental fact and opposite judgements, so both halves are one ask.
Whether the book already holds it. Drift on a position you own is a question about sizing; drift on one you do not is a question about entering, and they are not the same judgement.
